findings.description: render_finish applies the pending remainder through make_step, which can return early on the time check and skip ETA bookkeeping. The extra render_progress call also runs for hidden bars and non-TTY output.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a progress bar whose length is not a multiple of update_min_steps, finished with a pending remainder. make_step increments pos and then returns early if less than 1s has passed since last_eta, so only the pos update is guaranteed. render_progress is called unconditionally, so for non-TTY output it only prints the label once and does nothing new. The impact is minor and I cannot name a concrete wrong output, so confidence is low.
